browserRecoveryCampaign.design: Sequential tuning, followed by natural live checks. Distinct isolated Chrome profiles and owned local fixtures; up to two concurrent episodes. Every attempted episode and harness-debug failure is retained. Not a randomized frozen-code benchmark.
limitations: API latency/cache/load and seed determinism are uncontrolled.
A replay episode injects one historical failed response then uses the live model; it is not a natural failure-incidence measurement.
Model dispatch attempts include locally rejected calls; remote counts additionally include automatic snapshot observations.
Old raw grader false negatives are corrected uniformly in this derived summary without altering raw evidence.
A successful small sample does not guarantee correctness on arbitrary sites.
